messages.text:
Hi Team, sorry for late reply. Thanks for the video and photos.
I have decided to go with the Hammer Thor P2 because my studio is too small, and I prefer something quieter.
For the remaining balance difference of US$220.99, may I kindly check if it is possible to refund it to my original payment method instead of store credit? I would really appreciate your help with this.
And Yes, You can arrange the shipping for the Hammer Thor P2 to my shipping address.  And does it come with a Malaysia plug?
Thank you for your help.
Winson T.
(phone hidden)
Handed to the team · Swap blocked by the cancellation hold I placed, and the refund-to-card decision

Hi Winson,

Thanks for confirming, and no problem at all about the delay in replying.

Your choice is locked in: the Hammer Thor P2 (10TH/s) at $379, going to the same shipping address. It's on the shelf and ships within 2 business days once the change is made on the order. The difference against the $599.99 you paid is $220.99.

On getting that $220.99 back to your original payment method rather than store credit, that's a colleague's call, not mine, and they're on it today. The same colleague clears the hold that was put on your order when you asked about cancelling, which is the one thing standing between us and making the switch. You'll get the updated order email as soon as it's done, and nothing ships before then.

On the plug, the Thor P2 comes as "US / EU (matched to your address)", so there's no Malaysian Type G cord in the box, and since your order goes out from our US side it will come with the US cord. I've asked for the exact connector on your unit to be confirmed so you buy the right lead and nothing else. If you'd like that answer faster, our Discord is the quickest route, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where JD (@nullhashrate) and owners running these units will tell you exactly what to get.

And yes, once it lands I'll walk you through the setup step by step.

Talk soon,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Okay, Noted.
Thank you.

Winson T.

On the cord, the exact connector for your unit is being confirmed so you don't buy the wrong thing. If you want a faster answer in the meantime, our Discord is the place, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where JD (@nullhashrate) and other owners can tell you exactly what lead works in Malaysia.

Come straight back to me once it arrives and I'll take you through the setup step by step.

Talk soon,

Hi Winson,

Yes, there is movement. The hold on your order has come off, so Shop···· is clear and ready for the change to the Hammer Thor P2 at $379. Nothing has shipped, and the Thor P2 is on the shelf, so it goes out within 2 business days of the switch being made.

The one thing still open is the money. I've checked the exact figure and it is $220.99 coming back to you. As the change stands on my side, that amount lands as store credit on your account rather than on your card. Sending it back to your original payment method instead is a decision above me, and that is with a colleague who starts at 10am Eastern today. You'll have their answer by email.

If you'd rather not wait at all, tell me you're happy to take the $220.99 as store credit and I'll make the switch to the Thor P2 the same day you reply, so the miner starts moving. If you'd rather hold out for the card refund, that's completely fine too, just say so and nothing changes until the answer comes back.

On the cord, that confirmation is coming with the same update, so please don't buy anything yet.

Talk soon,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
